title: The pricing page and the plan story tell five tiers, selling at Business, read from the catalog
detail: PHASE 6 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709). PLAN_STORY rewritten (zero imports, ADR-1368); ADVERTISED_SPACE_PLANS adds Collective; the pricing page grid, plan cards, comparison table and FAQ follow best-practice structure (personal and Space toggles, one recommended card, the selling line at Business, fee ladder, FAQ). No typed price. Published /pricing documents in the pages table are re-published. Shipped 2026-10-06: PLAN_STORY rewritten as a zero-import leaf with ladder, selling, crew and collective lines; Collective advertised; /pricing rebuilt with a For your Space / For you toggle, one recommended card (Business), a selling line read off Offering.sells, a fee ladder table, the comparison (multi-pipeline rows off by owner ruling, QR row reads editable codes), a who-it's-for band linking /for/teachers, and the FAQ; the pricing CMS template follows. Published /pricing documents in the pages table still carry the old words until the owner re-publishes them.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const ps=r("lib/pricing/plan-story.ts");if(/^import /m.test(ps))fail("plan-story.ts imports something");if(/free Space sells|sells tickets, takes donations/i.test(ps))fail("PLAN_STORY still says a free Space sells");if(!/Collective/.test(ps))fail("PLAN_STORY never names Collective");if(!/collective/.test((r("lib/pricing/display.ts").split("ADVERTISED_SPACE_PLANS")[1]||"").split("\n\n")[0]))fail("Collective is not advertised");if(/Every rung on both sells/i.test(r("app/(marketing)/pricing/page.tsx")))fail("the pricing page still says every rung sells");console.log("ok: the pricing page tells the ladder")'
